name: Wrist Circle
steps: Stand or sit tall with your elbows bent comfortably near your sides and make loose fists or interlace your fingers lightly in front of your chest.
Rotate both wrists smoothly in wide, controlled circles in one direction while keeping your forearms steady.
Move evenly through the full comfortable range of wrist flexion, extension, and side-to-side motion.
Reverse direction halfway through and continue circling smoothly for the target duration.
tips: Move slowly enough to feel every part of the circle rather than spinning your hands loosely.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and avoid tensing your forearms excessively.
